mapper.select: SELECT i.*, u1.username AS publisherName, u2.username AS claimerName FROM item i LEFT JOIN user u1 ON i.user_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN claim c ON i.id = c.item_id AND c.status = 0 LEFT JOIN user u2 ON c.user_id = u2.id WHERE i.status = #{status} ORDER BY i.id DESC

SELECT i.*, u1.username AS publisherName, u2.username AS claimerName FROM item i LEFT JOIN user u1 ON i.user_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN claim c ON i.id = c.item_id AND c.status = 0 LEFT JOIN user u2 ON c.user_id = u2.id WHERE i.status IN (1, 2) ORDER BY i.id DESC
